title: Animated Shiny Text (Magic UI)
notes:
A light glare effect which pans across text making it appear as if it is shimmering.

Install into a project: npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/animated-shiny-text

Original file: https://github.com/magicuidesign/magicui/blob/main/apps/www/registry/magicui/animated-shiny-text.tsx
